items.summary: Maintain containment-only execution this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, with measurement, repair, security, and readiness work open. Create no new proposals, queue items, experiments, telemetry requests, deployments, spend, credential changes, or configuration changes. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as the next reversible candidate after one slot is released and the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case is resolved or closed. Use the recorded baseline of 61 affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21. Measure only registered affiliate clicks and available downstream attribution. Prototype: one isolated CTA hierarchy and accessibility diff preserving destination, disclosure, consent behavior, and unrelated routes. Rollback: single-diff revert.

Retain complicated.work as the strongest site-factory pipeline candidate, but readiness-only work remains bounded to the existing packet. The packet must document owner, audience, launch scope, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics and affiliate boundaries, compliance, security, measurement, rollback, and launch disposition. Keep the site private and preview-only. Do not build, deploy, spend, add domains, add credentials, or change production.

Revenue evidence remains bounded. Amazon data covers 2026-09-21 with 6219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission, which remains unattributed. Do not claim site-level revenue, conversion lift, ROI, margin, forecast, or causal impact. Current analytics gaps remain unknown, not zero.

Keep private-launch and security gates unchanged. Continue only existing evidence work for rights, privacy, consent, claims, security controls, attribution, measurement, and owner disposition. No public exposure, external outreach, security-sensitive release, or monetization expansion is admissible from this plan.
